cases.expected_meaning: Retain two distinct official policy documents: January1,2026 IAP.001.28 with26pages; October1,2026 IAP.001.31 with23pages. Effective dates are distinct from capture and HTTP Last-Modified.

January page22 explicitly removes Erickson Advantage H5652-001 through H5652-008 from excluded plans. This is relevant exact contract-range evidence, not a personal drug coverage or universal no-exception conclusion.
Application pages say most UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plans and preserve listed plan exceptions. Do not strip most or the exact plan/year context.

Where a delegate manages utilization management and prior authorization, delegate requirements must be followed. Preserve this conditional; do not require proof of universal nondelegation merely to retain a qualified source statement.

Instructions retain plan-specific EOC/SB provisions and their printed discrepancy rule, and Medicare NCD/LCD/manual conflict rule. These are source-specific roles, not a new general source-precedence engine.

October revision history archives IAP.001.30. January and October captures are not an exhaustive2026 version chain; do not invent January end-date, uninterrupted interval, future absence proof or automatic supersession scope.
EOC2 identifies UnitedHealthcare insurance/affiliate and we/us/our semantics for this exact plan. EOC78 supplies the member list pointer. Do not replace these with a generic brand association.

Acquisition and bounded application-page review do not interpret every drug table or criterion. No patient prescription, diagnosis, new-start status, preferred product, covered indication or individual utilization decision is established.
Retain exact originals, URLs, byte hashes, page counts, rendered-page provenance and observed source-access status. No login,403bypass, outreach, DB change, source acceptance or denominator change.

scope: Acquisition and bounded application/version provenance only; not every drug criterion. Producer sent source locator/status leads.
